steps.title: Audit: verify every stage on real images
steps.note: Started 2026-10-28 after reviewing all 128 real-data panels (figures/review/gallery.html; findings in status/visual_review_2026-10-28.md). Plan in status/verification_plan.md: gates G0-G5, each passed only after every panel of a real-image gallery is reviewed. Running now: mask QC + death-label checks (agy), raw volumes for the gallery panels (then the in-depth chambers).

steps.title: Fix the foundation
steps.note: Portable paths, VOXEL_UM = 0.1962, report status notes. Commit 067c571.

steps.title: Download all 63,053 masks (~4.3 GB)
steps.note: All 63,053 masks downloaded and validated, 0 failures (2026-10-27). data/scidb_19235_masks/ with manifest.csv.

steps.title: Reproduce the lab's published numbers
steps.note: Verified on external checks: trace_num==1 count equals the paper's row count in all 12 fully deposited experiments (395/395); chamber identity firm for 415/419 rows; masks-only contact area within 0.5% for 369/419. Gate G0 passed. Not yet checked visually; gate G1 covers the same masks.

steps.title: Build per-cell death labels
steps.note: AUDIT G2. Labels exist for all 502 chambers (contacted target only, 200-min window, ROI_0 band excluded), but are not verified. Gallery panels overlap dye with every target in the field, labels with the contacted target only: death_surviving_19, 24 and death_killed_07 disagree with their labels. Possible overlap bug (death_dasatinib_30), possible neighbour false kills (death_killed_05, 09). Faint dye (threshold 404 vs background ~400): threshold sensitivity running in the QC job.

steps.title: Describe every chamber, and 10-20 in depth
steps.note: AUDIT G1/G3. 5a descriptors exist but the cup measurements are inflated where the target mask is not one whole cell: fragmented (cup_01 10.2 um), two targets merged (deep_07 5.6 um), hollow (dasatinib_11 6.75 um), cut by the image edge (cup_05, cup_13). Median cup depth 0.72 um (compact targets) vs 1.35 um (least compact). Donor hd10 masks mostly fragmented/hollow. QC flags running; recompute on clean cells, then re-verify visually. Raw volumes for all 121 gallery panels downloading.

steps.title: Does geometry relate to killing at all?
steps.note: AUDIT G4, on hold. The pre-registered association (deeper cups, faster killing, HR 1.4/SD) may be partly mask artefact if targets fragment before death. Rerun on verified G1-G3 data, old result kept for comparison.

steps.title: First mechanical model
steps.note: PARKED (G5). Solver fixed and passes analytic and contact benchmarks, but on real data: solved cells drift 2-3 um off the masks (no rigid-body pinning); re-solve disagrees with the fit curve in 9/32 panels; starting target misplaced (overlap up to 11 um); one curve-inversion inconsistency (fit_reach_14). Final run stopped. Resume only if G4 still shows something to explain.

steps.title: Ask one sharp question
steps.note: AUDIT G4, on hold. Pre-registered result was inconclusive (dasatinib control failed on depth/radius). The hd10 outlier that drove part of it has mostly fragmented/hollow masks. Rerun after G1-G3.
